Keep commands, credentials, parameter val"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ues and any other important snippets at hand while working — and feed them back into the conversatio"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" important snippets at hand while working — and feed them back into the conversation with one click."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Floating dock** — an animated notebook icon on the right edge of the chat window, one click away"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" at all times. Drag it anywhere (the position persists); it honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Co"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"nfigurable placement & size** — in **Settings → Plugins → Plugin Configuration** the dock can be set"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" to **floating** (draggable) or **fixed** (pinned to the chat window's top-right corner, not draggab"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"le), and the button size to **Small / Regular / Large**. Changes apply live — no reload.
- **Notes p"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"anel** — slide-over panel with search, a note list (title, preview, tags, relative time), and per-no"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"te actions.
- **Dismissing the panel** — the X, ESC, the dock button, a click outside the panel, and"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" (on touch) a bottom **Close** button all dismiss it. Every dismissal **persists an in-progress draf"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"t** instead of losing it; the editor's **Cancel** is the one explicit discard.
- **Touch / coarse-po"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"inter ready** — on touch devices every control grows to at least a 44px target, the per-note actions"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" become a permanent tappable row instead of hover-only pills (which are unreachable without a hover)"},{"id":"p6s12","text":", the resize gutter widens, and a bottom **Close** button lands in the thumb zone. Fine-pointer desk"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"tops keep the compact layout unchanged.
- **Insert into the composer** — one click places the note's"},{"id":"p6s14","text":" content into the current session's input box (the title stays a list label), ready to review and se"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"nd. When no session is open, the content is copied to the clipboard instead.
- **Save any selection*"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"* — select text anywhere on the page (e.g. part of an AI answer) and a floating **"Save as note"** b"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"utton appears; one click captures it, with the first line as the title. The bubble **follows the sel"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"ection while you scroll** and only disappears when the selection collapses, you click elsewhere on t"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"he page, or you switch windows.

Add the package name there (or ship a `cordis.patch.yml` insert via an aggregator bundle)"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"d the package name there (or ship a `cordis.patch.yml` insert via an aggregator bundle) and restart."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Verify the install"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"After restarting dsh web, the notebook icon appears on the right edge of the chat window (see Usage)"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"fter restarting dsh web, the notebook icon appears on the right edge of the chat window (see Usage)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Update"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm, so updating is just pnpm's `update` — no manifest edits needed (the p"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"rofile reconciles its bundle list against what is installed on the next `dsh plugin` run), then rest"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ciles its bundle list against what is installed on the next `dsh plugin` run), then restart dsh web:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"> **Mirror sync delay**: publishing goes to the official registry, but mirrors like npmmirror sync o"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"n a delay — right after a release your default registry may still serve the previous version (or bri"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"efly 404). If an update "does nothing" after a new release, point at the official registry with `--r"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"egistry https://registry.npmjs.org/`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"> Updates never touch your notes: they live on the host at `$DSH_HOME/notes/notes.json` and your set"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"tings survive an upgrade."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"1. Click the notebook icon on the right edge of the chat window.
2. Click **New** to write a note (t"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"itle optional — defaults to the first line), or select any text on the page and click **Save as note"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"**.
3. In the note list:
- **Insert** — puts the note into the input box of the current session (app"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ended after any existing draft); press Enter to send.
- **Copy** — copies title + content to the cli"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"pboard.
- **Edit** / **Delete** — manage the note."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Notes are searchable by title, content and tags (comma-separated in the editor)."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The plugin registers a `notes` settings namespace and a settings card in **Settings → Plugins → Plug"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"in Configuration** (the namespace is also editable via `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`):"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"All five options are editable live in the settings card; the dock and panel pick up changes immediat"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"five options are editable live in the settings card; the dock and panel pick up changes immediately."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Notes may contain credentials, tokens, or other sensitive values. They are stored **in plaintext** i"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"n a local JSON file (`~/.dsh/notes/notes.json`, same trust model as `~/.dsh/credentials.yaml`) and a"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"re served only to the loopback browser UI. Do not store secrets you cannot afford to expose on this "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"machine, and protect the file with your OS-level user permissions. Exporting/backing up that file al"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"so exports every note."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"`scripts/verify-touch.mjs` drives `scripts/harness/entry.tsx` — a standalone harness that renders th"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"e REAL `NotesDock` component tree with the REAL `NOTES_CSS` against mocked host contracts (notes API"},{"id":"p37s3","text":", sessions store, settings scope) — in headless Chrome over CDP. It asserts the coarse-pointer adapt"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"ation and every dismissal path, and writes `.logs/touch-desktop.png` / `.logs/touch-coarse.png` for "},{"id":"p37s5","text":"smissal path, and writes `.logs/touch-desktop.png` / `.logs/touch-coarse.png` for visual inspection."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
